title: A bit disappointed ...
text: A bit disappointed .... I thought this product would hold all my wraps & foils: it doesn't.  Will hold the smaller bags (sandwich & snack) but when it came to the foils/wraps, they were too long.  I'm using the second one for my oven mitts/pads and may try to modify the rack to push it back a bit ... just be aware that it may not hold all you want it to.  Wanted to put my cook books in one but the back falls down as they're too heavy: here again, may use cup hooks to hold up the back so I can put my cook books here.  Nice idea ... just falls a bit short in its intentions.
